global.title: Central settings
global.description: These settings apply to all rooms. East, south and west are derived automatically from the north-facade azimuth.

data_description.workday_entity: Optional binary sensor provided by Home Assistant's Workday integration. It enables separate rules for workdays and days off/public holidays.
data_description.azimuth_north: 0° is geographic north. East, south and west are derived automatically as +90°, +180° and +270°.

room.title: Create a new room
room.description: Set the room and its temperature sensor.

covers.title: Covers in this room
covers.description: Assign every cover to exactly one building side.

cover_contact.title: Contact for “{cover}”
cover_contact.description: Cover {number} of {total}. The window/door contact is optional and affects only this cover.

behavior.title: Temperatures and movement behavior
behavior.description: Set temperature thresholds, movement limits, manual override behavior and tilt activation. Target positions are configured in the next step.

data.window_safe_position: Safety position for an open contact
data.tilted_min_position: Minimum opening for a tilted contact
data.manual_override_minutes: Manual override duration (no later than the next day change)

data_description.manual_override_minutes: This room value can be adjusted individually. Saving the global lock duration again will replace it with the global value.

initial_time_rules.title: Time rules for this room
initial_time_rules.description: Create individual movement events. Each rule opens or closes the selected covers at one trigger time. You may also save the room without a time rule.

initial_rule_basics.title: Time rule – basics
initial_rule_basics.description: This movement rule applies to this room. Close holds the covers at the configured time-rule closing position until the next matching Open event ends the rule.

data_description.day_type: Independent of the Workday sensor, workdays only, or days off/public holidays only.
data_description.priority: If multiple rules stored in the room affect the same cover at the same instant, the higher priority wins. With equal priority, the stored rule order decides.
data_description.action: Close starts the scheduled closing state and moves to the time-rule closing position. Open ends it, moves to the open position, and then releases dynamic shading.

initial_rule_trigger.title: Time rule – trigger
initial_rule_trigger.description: Choose a fixed time, sunrise or sunset.

initial_rule_trigger_value.title: Time rule – trigger value
initial_rule_trigger_value.description: For a sun event, a negative offset is before and a positive offset is after the event.

global_positions.title: Global position defaults
global_positions.description: Set the default values for new rooms. Each room then stores independent position values and can be adjusted separately. 0% means fully closed and 100% fully open.

positions.title: Positions for this room
positions.description: These values are stored in this room. Saving the central position values again replaces every position value in this room. Afterwards they can be customized here again. 0% means fully closed and 100% fully open.

data_description.time_rule_close_position: This position is used by every time rule with the Close action, especially night closing.
data_description.wind_safe_position: Used only when wind protection is enabled.
data_description.storm_safe_position: Used only when wind and storm protection is enabled.
data_description.rain_safe_position: Used only when rain protection is enabled.
data_description.frost_safe_position: Used only when frost protection and the Frost action Safety position are enabled.

global_manual_override.title: Global manual-operation lock duration
global_manual_override.description: Set the default duration for manual overrides. New rooms inherit this value as their template.

data.global_manual_override_minutes: Global lock duration (no later than the next day change)

contact_unknown.title: Contact state unknown
contact_unknown.description: Contact {entity} in room {room} is unavailable or unknown. The configured fail-safe strategy is active.

cover_stop_unsupported.title: Emergency stop unsupported
cover_stop_unsupported.description: Cover {entity} in room {room} does not support stop. A moving cover cannot be actively stopped after contact loss.

cover_tilt_unsupported.title: Tilt control unsupported
cover_tilt_unsupported.description: Cover {entity} in room {room} does not support slat tilt control.

provider_degraded.title: Cover provider degraded
provider_degraded.description: Several cover commands in room {room} failed. The integration is using adaptive retry.

weather_forecast_unavailable.title: Weather forecast unavailable
weather_forecast_unavailable.description: The shared hourly forecast from weather entity {entity} could not be loaded. Forecast-based evaluation is temporarily unavailable in all rooms.

invalid_irradiance_unit.title: Invalid irradiance unit
invalid_irradiance_unit.description: Entity {entity} uses unsupported unit {unit}. Supported units are W/m² and kW/m².

invalid_illuminance_unit.title: Invalid illuminance unit
invalid_illuminance_unit.description: Entity {entity} uses unsupported unit {unit}. Supported units are lx and klx.

invalid_wind_unit.title: Invalid wind-speed unit
invalid_wind_unit.description: Entity {entity} uses unsupported unit {unit}. Supported units are km/h, m/s, mph, and kn.

missing_entity.title: Configured entity missing
missing_entity.description: Configured entity {entity} in room {room} does not exist.

cover_position_unsupported.title: Partial position unsupported
cover_position_unsupported.description: Cover {entity} in room {room} does not support percentage positions. Partial targets are safely mapped to fully open or closed.

workday_unavailable.title: Workday sensor unavailable
workday_unavailable.description: The globally configured Workday sensor {entity} is unavailable. Workday-dependent rules cannot be evaluated reliably.

sun_event_unavailable.title: Sun event unavailable
sun_event_unavailable.description: The globally configured sun entity {entity} does not provide all sun events required by the configured time rules. Home Assistant location data is used as fallback.

duplicate_cover_assignment.title: Cover assigned more than once
duplicate_cover_assignment.description: At least one of these covers is already used by another room: {covers}. Affected room: {room}.

invalid_temperature_unit.title: Unsupported temperature unit
invalid_temperature_unit.description: The temperature entity {entity} uses the unsupported unit “{unit}”. Select an entity with a Home Assistant temperature unit or correct the entity configuration.

workday_configuration_missing.title: Workday configuration missing
workday_configuration_missing.description: At least one global or room-specific time rule depends on workday classification, but no global Workday sensor is configured. Select a Workday sensor or change the affected rules to “Any day”.

global_missing_entity.title: Configured global entity missing
global_missing_entity.description: The globally configured entity {entity} does not exist.
